query: Write a 3-minute spoken script for our product film. The visuals are already built.
expected_behavior: Reads the repo, claim ledger, landing page, and brand tokens before asking questions.
Uses a six-beat map with a 20s hook, 25s pain, two 45s demo beats, 30s proof, and 15s vision.
Keeps the read at 135-145 words per minute and leaves 8-11 seconds of screen time in the demo beats.
Replaces jargon with plain spoken language and puts numbers on screen where they belong.
Writes pause marks in the read script and keeps them out of the VO string.
Confirms the brief and asks only for missing decisions.
baseline_failure: Without the skill, the model writes landing-page copy with uneven density: a packed 20s hook and a 45s demo beat that finishes in half the time.
